_note: The render formats this app implements natively. A tool is installable iff its tools.json `format` appears in this list AND its `installKind` is not "plugin". Read by BOTH src-tauri/src/registry.rs (include_str!) and src/lib/data/toolRegistry.ts (JSON import) — never restate this list in code. Adding a renderer means adding its format here, and the docs guard then forces README.md and landing/index.html to list the tool.
